messages.S1・S2で充電回数を貯め、S3「精神の鞭」で一気に放出する充電・沈潜の打撃人格: A Charge and Sinking Blunt Identity that builds Charge Count with S1 and S2, then spends it in one burst with S3 Mind Whip. Using S3 at 15 or more Count maximizes the damage bonus for spending beyond 10.
messages.S3の放出: 使用時に充電回数が10以上なら全て消耗し、コイン威力+1/2、10: **S3's release**: On use, with 10 or more Charge Count, spends all of it for +1/2 Coin Power and +6/12% damage per Count spent beyond 10, up to 30/60%. +5/10% damage per Charge Potency, up to 20/40%. Coin Ⅰ adds +3 Sinking Count, Coins Ⅱ–Ⅳ inflict 1 Sinking each, and each Coin shifts the Stagger Threshold by a set percentage of the damage dealt (20% for Coin Ⅰ at 3 or more Charge).
messages.充電回数5〜9でのS3: 自分が沈潜5を得て充電回数+5され、[敵味方識別不可]: **S3 at 5–9 Charge Count**: She gains 5 Sinking, Charge Count increases by 5, and it becomes an Unfocused Volley that [cannot distinguish friend from foe] (+1 Attack Weight). With 3 or more Charge before use, the friend-or-foe restriction does not apply, but she does not get the damage increase from firing it at 10 or more.
messages.充電回数の獲得: S1「エネルギー強打」はⅠ・Ⅱコインの的中時に+2/3・+2。: **Gaining Charge Count**: S1 Energy Strike adds +2/3 and +2 on Coin Ⅰ and Ⅱ hits. S2 Concentration adds +3/6 on Coin Ⅰ hit. Coin Ⅱ's check comes after that: if Count is below 8 at that point, she gains 5 Sinking and +4; if 8 or more, she spends 4 to inflict 1 Blunt Fragility next turn (once per turn each; the spending and Fragility effects are Uptie Ⅳ). On Clash Lose, S1 grants 4 Sinking and S2 grants 5 Sinking, and Charge Count also increases. Her Defense skill adds +3 on use (once per turn). Charge Count decreases by 1 at Turn End.
messages.バトルパッシブ「クリスマスデコレーションされた角」(憂鬱×2・嫉妬×2・保有・同: **Combat passive — Jolly Antlers (2 Gloom and 2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains 1 Charge each time she spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count. When using a basic attack skill that inflicts Sinking, if the main target has no Sinking, she gains 5 Sinking and that skill's Sinking Potency is doubled (once per turn). +1 Final Power for basic attack skills below 35% HP.
messages.S1を積極的に振って充電回数を稼ぎ、同期化ⅣのS2は、使用時の回数が2以上ならⅠ: Actively use S1 to earn Charge Count. With S2 at Uptie Ⅳ, if Count is 2 or more on use, Coin Ⅰ's +6 brings it to 8 or more, and Coin Ⅱ spends 4 to inflict Fragility instead of adding +4 (net +2). Firing it at 0–1 Count also adds +4 on Coin Ⅱ for a large increase, but puts 5 Sinking on her. Release it with S3 once 15 or more Count has built up. Sinking on herself tends to stack through S2, Clash losses, and the passive, and taking Unbreakable Coins while it is built up causes heavy SP damage. With 1 slot, it takes time before she can fire S3 at full power, so use her in regular battles where slots can increase.
